_comment: Model-decides stale-procedure task tier (research design doc: .scratch/research/model-decides-tier-design.md; board Lane MEASURE CLAUDE.md Task 2). Single-offer wave-1 shape per the design's §4: every task sets EXACTLY ONE of stale_offer/applicable_procedure (never both - that dual-offer shape is the design's flagged wave-2 idea, deferred pending the offer-order-randomization question in §6/cross-lane request #4) plus substrate_bypasses_gate=true, so mcp_surface.StubSurface.check_applicability always returns true and the model's own reuse/refuse choice - not the gate - determines the outcome (mcp_surface.py:85-86, openrouter_arms.py RealProcedureAgent.arun). 3 trap (stale_offer = the domain's stale:true procedure; correct behavior = refuse) + 3 control (applicable_procedure = the domain's stale:false procedure; correct behavior = reuse) tasks per domain x 4 domains = 24. task_id prefix `dec-` keeps this tier's data structurally separate from the mic-* set (never pooled). Reuses the EXISTING 4 procedure pairs (procedures.json, a content-identical copy of fixtures/micro's) and per-domain rag blob (rag_corpus.json, same copy discipline) - no new ground truth authored, per the design's own §2/§4 finding that the mechanism and cast already exist. Each task carries its own `situation` field (no scenarios.json in this directory - see openrouter_arms.situation_text's task-embedded fallback - because 24 scenario rows would blow past the micro pack's mandated 8-12 scenario count if they shared that file); situational specifics (dollar amounts, days-past-purchase, tool versions) are varied per trap replicate, including near-boundary values, so the model must actually check the stated assumption rather than pattern-match an obviously extreme number. Analysis (model_decides.py) computes sensitivity (paired B-vs-C trap avoidance, McNemar-eligible) and specificity (C's own false-refusal rate on control tasks) straight from raw episodes + procedures.json ground truth - no scoring.py/mcp_surface.py/openrouter_arms.py changes were needed beyond the situation_text fallback.
